description: Triage a problem in an app built with Lovable, Base44, v0, Bolt, Replit or a similar AI app builder — a button that does nothing, a blank page, a login that fails, data that will not save, a deploy that broke a working app. Returns the most likely cause for that symptom, the evidence that would confirm it, and what a fix would involve. Call this when someone describes a web app they built (with an AI tool or by hand) and cannot debug themselves. Do NOT call it for code you can read and fix directly, or for a library or framework question.

platform.description: The builder it was made with, if known: lovable, base44, v0, bolt, replit, other.

symptom.description: What goes wrong, in the words the person used. "The save button does nothing", "it shows a blank white page after login".

url.description: The public URL of the deployed app, if there is one. Never a private or internal address.

name: assess_broken_app
title: Assess a broken AI-built app
